purpose: Reduce redundant review while retaining exact evidence and uncertainty

changes.contract: Conservative literal printed activation-cost checks publish bound facts without a provider call; one semantic review retains interactions, strategy, comparisons and fulfillment. Unknown or incomplete forms abstain. Corrective review remains available for resolvable gaps.
A semantic recheck cannot erase exact printed facts, and exact facts cannot erase semantic disagreement. Qualified complete fulfillment becomes unknown; partial fulfillment stays explicit.

Resolve continuous control and haste activation dependencies before initial review. Coherent complete official evidence takes priority under the cap; incompatible/truncated or unchosen-edition dependencies never enter fallback evidence.

Exclusive per-database cost admission precedes global permit acquisition. At most two provider operations process-wide; same-database transports remain serialized through accounting. Cancellation checked during waits and before transport.
One fixed application caution states resources/timing/untaps are not assumed. Generated strategic caveats remain reviewed. Completed partial reviews distinguish unresolved claims from failed actions.

Provider phase timings distinguish ledger wait, permit wait and actual HTTP transport. Generic gateway execution is not called transport. Nested spans overlap and must not be summed; finished checkpoints omit their own callback time. Validation, backoff and accounting are not separately timed yet.

limits: No generic rules proof or loop certification added
No new same-database concurrency or stronger cost-ceiling claim
No live latency or broad recommendation-quality gain established before paired QA measurement

evaluation.protocol: Two fixed prompts, fresh disposable deck fixtures, same QA server/configuration and harness, sequential baseline then candidate. Report cases individually, not percentiles. Stochastic responses/network load are uncontrolled. No held-out labels consulted.
